finalText:
1. Grep (parallel batch): search config/ for retry_count — run several targeted greps together (e.g. by subdirectory or file extension) in one parallel block rather than one at a time, since they don't depend on each other.
2. For each file that matched, Edit: replace retry_count with max_retries at each hit.
3. Verification: one grep for retry_count across config/ after all edits — a clean zero-match result is the confirmation; the edit tool already errors loudly if any individual edit failed to apply, so I wouldn't re-read the changed files one by one.

I'd skip the search subagent here — the repo is small (~40 files) and I already know where the configs live; the subagent is for when I don't know where things live, not for a known, bounded sweep like this.
